title: Planning the journey
author: ONE HOME original transition guide
pages:
1. Check the route from home to the correct campus.

Try this: make a short note about how this applies to your own plans. Think of one practical action you could take, who could help, and what information you still need. Your experience may differ from someone else’s, so use your college’s own guidance for dates and arrangements.

Before moving on, explain this step to yourself in your own words. You do not have to know everything at once. A useful next action is more helpful than a perfect plan that you never begin.
